description: §5.2.3 (S435, L19 reversed) — the canonical inline block handler `onclick={ @count = 0; @phase = .Idle; track("reset") }` compiles without E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER and runs all three statements, in order, on one click. Source is §5.2.3's own inline-block worked example.
rationale: §5.2.3 (amended S435): "An event-handler attribute value MAY be an inline block: a `{`, a statement list, and the matching `}`"; "On each dispatch of the event, the statements of an inline block SHALL run in source order, each one exactly once"; "An inline block (`{ … }`) never fires" E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER (§34 row, narrowed S435). One click: count 5 → 0, phase .Loading → .Idle, track sets last to "reset".
